exposure: Receipt of infant feeding recommendations from health workers
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding rate at six months
cohort: Professional working mothers in one of the ten regional capitals of Ghana
finding: Despite high breastfeeding initiation rates, the exclusive breastfeeding rate at six months was low among professional working mothers in Ghana, and factors such as lack of infant feeding recommendations, shorter maternity leave, and caesarean delivery were associated with lower EBF rates.
mod_finding: Mothers who had a normal delivery were almost 10 times as likely to practice exclusive breastfeeding compared to those who had a caesarean or abnormal delivery.
